column1: # Expected seconds per runner test file, for runner/test/run.sh --shard (lib/shard.mjs
# balances the shards with these). seconds<TAB>file. Source: CI run 41154291906 (main
# at 692cf14), the median of the two macOS samples per file (the node 22 3-shard and
# node 24 2-shard cells; every file ran once in each), on macOS runners under -j 3 or
# -j 5 (the CPU count varies by runner), rounded, floor 1. The ubuntu cells (-j 4)
# ran the slow tests at 0.9-2x these times, in much the same order. Only the ratios
# matter.
# A test missing here counts 10s; a line for a deleted test is ignored.
# Refresh a line when a test gets much slower or faster — an off weight only unbalances
# the shards, it never drops or duplicates a test.
# memory-index-after-merge, rework-cost-live, export-under-load: ESTIMATES, not CI
# medians (refresh them from the next CI run). Linux, alone: 70s / 36s / 9s; under load
# memory-index-after-merge took 156s where merge-lane took 249s against its 171 here,
# and the three are scaled by that ratio (rework-cost-live rounded up).
# land-tester-replay, e2e-release-gate-tester-replay: ESTIMATES (Linux under shared load:
# 290s / 98s while other suites ran; refresh from the next CI run). External review #7
# added two repos' worth of deliveries to each (Linux, -j 2: 391s / 172s) and the
# reviewer's two-repo sequence plus two real poll ticks to e2e-multi-repo-delivery (76s).
# rework-final-trail: ESTIMATE too (Linux, alone: 33s, scaled like memory-index-after-merge).
# dashboard-lifecycle, gaffer-colour, demo-isolation: ESTIMATES (Linux, -j 2: 37s / 13s / 48s).
# e2e-release-gate-merge-typecheck: ESTIMATE too. Linux, one at a time under shared
# load: 131s where e2e-release-gate-merge-combination took 103s against its 100 here.
# landing-revocation, secondary-pr-landing, cleanup-ownership, replay-recovery: ESTIMATES
# (external review #8; Linux alone: 77s / 81s / 169s / 34s, scaled like the others;
# replay-recovery: 61s alone once it gained the merge-lane and red-replay cases).
# landing-revocation-window: ESTIMATE (Linux alone: 40s, scaled like the others).
# land-tester-replay-proof: split out of land-tester-replay (sections G-K) once the one
# file passed run.sh's 600s long cap on ubuntu (CI run 41322221909). ESTIMATES: the old
# 270 scaled by the ~25% the cleanup-ownership checks and the auth probe added, shared
# by the split's measured ratio (Linux, both at once under shared load: 875s / 748s).
# poll-overlap-run-state: ESTIMATE (Linux alone under shared load: 90s, two real Polls
# and a loop pass; refresh from the next CI run).
# Refreshed 2026-11-01 from CI run 41333739591 (macOS node 24 shard 2/2, -j 3) for every file it ran;
# the files added at the end with no CI sample yet are ESTIMATES: auth-gate-delivery, budget-refused-delivery,
# daemon-sigint, multi-repo-landing-preflight, usage-limit-lanes, tick-parked-result, paid-launch-cap-required and the small docs/docker/provenance checks.
